research: docs/research/2026-11-story-statics.md: the long-running statics carry 5-6 layers; 7 story statics (hook, quote, list, versus, stack) carry them in our own type, each with a verbatim review
Wouter 2026-11-04: every static shows the offer; the 9 offer-led samples 'could work': the offer-led and story formats, each once, plus one format of our own (the window mist)
The team 2026-11-04: 'story is not enough': every static names its story (problem_fix 5, moment 4, proof 5, gift 4, value 4, ways 3) and one line that says why
Five story scenes are the approved sample stills of 4 Nov (same prompts, gated and looked at); 2 concept scenes also ship as motion stills (rain on the window, fairy lights)
